content.text:
Silhouette: Four-legged cheetah frame. Host frame: the cheetah sets the outline, body size and overall frame. A single creature combining an emperor penguin and a cheetah. The head is that of the cheetah, fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Details: cheetah body and legs with dense fur and cheetah-type spots on the face, neck, shoulders, belly, hips, legs and tail; from the emperor penguin, as parts and materials on the cheetah's own body, layered contour feathers in its own colors grown from the skin as the cheetah's own covering over the back and flanks, replacing the cheetah's dense fur there and conforming to the cheetah's body, sized to the cheetah's body and following its contours; every covered part keeps the cheetah's own length and shape; the dense fur stops at the covering's edge, and the face, neck, shoulders, belly, hips, legs and tail keep the cheetah's own dense fur. The covering follows the body's own shape. Bilaterally symmetrical, with recognizable limbs and visible sense organs. Habitat cue (alpine meadow): shorter ears and tail, dense coat for the cold. Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.

summary.text:
**Designing hybrid creature concept**
I'm planning a single creature that uses a cheetah's four-legged frame and head with clear eyes, then layers emperor penguin contour feathers over the body and adds cheetah spots across the face, neck, shoulders, belly, hips, legs, and tail.
**Drafting hybrid illustration prompt**
I'm organizing the cheetah-penguin hybrid details into a natural history illustration prompt, keeping the cheetah head and limbs with dense fur, and layering emperor penguin contour feathers on the back and flanks with black, white, and yellow accents.
**Refining hybrid illustration prompt**
I'm adjusting the prompt to add proper feather detail to the penguin and preparing another generation so the image looks complete.
**Refining penguin separation**
I'm adjusting the hybrid illustration to keep the penguin as a distinct element, clarifying its placement and edges so it stands apart from the other components.
